measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow the City of Garrison to levy an additional 1% sales tax for Garrison Fire Department projects within the city. The added tax would follow the same provisions, limits and exemptions in the city’s Home Rule Charter.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the additional 1% sales tax for fire-department projects within Garrison under the charter’s existing provisions, limits and exemptions.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed additional fire-department sales tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Shorten the summer dates when fireworks may be used in Horace from June 27 through July 6 to July 3 through July 5 each year. Initiated Ordinance No. 2026-12 would make this change to the city’s fireworks rules.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve changing the summer fireworks-use period to July 3 through July 5 each year.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed change to the summer fireworks-use dates.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow the City of Rolette to levy up to ten mills in property taxes annually for ten taxable years for a fire-department capital-improvements fund. The fund could pay for fire-department capital improvements, equipment purchases, and maintenance of structural and mechanical parts of fire stations.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed fire-department capital levy of up to ten mills annually for ten taxable years.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed fire-department capital levy.
